text_block_list.text:
It's finally time for the autumn Tenno
Sho!
text_block_list.name: Interviewer

text_block_list.text:
Could you please tell us how you feel
right now,
before the race?
text_block_list.name: Interviewer

text_block_list.text:
I could... but before that, may I do a
little
performance?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Of course!
text_block_list.name: Interviewer

text_block_list.text:
She plucks a rose seemingly from thin
air, then
covers it with a handkerchief.
Fwoosh

Now then, where do you think the rose
has gone?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Whoa! It's really gone. I don't see it in
either of
your hands! Wait...
text_block_list.name: Interviewer

text_block_list.text:
Huh?! When did it end up in my
pocket?!
text_block_list.name: Interviewer

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I heard it was your birthday today,
so I
wanted to give you a present.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
W-wow, thank you so much! You're in
top form
today, aren't you?
text_block_list.name: Interviewer

text_block_list.text:
I'd like to think I am. I just have to do
what I must.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
And what I must do is provide you all
with the
most wondrous, heart-stopping
entertainment.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Ooh, look at her expression! Her vibe is
totally
different than usual. I just know
we're in for a
treat today!
text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan A

text_block_list.text:
Everyone in the section over there, take
out your
handkerchiefs with Fuji's colors
now!
text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan B

text_block_list.text:
Remember to wave them at chest height!
Don't
forget cheering etiquette, and
let's have a good
one today!
text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan B

text_block_list.text: Roger! Aah, I'm so excited!
text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan A

text_block_list.text: Perfect. The seed has been planted.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
As for you, Trainer, all you have to do is
relax...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
And wait for me to bring back the
victory.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
choice_data_list: You seem ready for anything today.

text_block_list.text:
When I say that, her collected
expression cracks
just a little.
Hehe. Good.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you and Mother, I finally
know what I
have to do.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer. I'm all right now. I'll
be sure
to give everyone a great time.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
After all, I'm your evening star, sparkling
in the
night sky.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
